answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 12919 Country: United States of America Title: What is the meaning of 'Hamna', can I choose this name for my daughter? Can you please also provide some good girl names. JazakAllah. Question: What is the meaning of 'Hamna', can I choose this name for my daughter? Can you please also provide some good girl names. JazakAllah. Answer ID: 12919 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 834/834=M/1430) Hamna ( حمنۃ ) is right Arabic word; it is a kind of insect. There was a Sahabiyah named Hamnah bint Jahash. So, you can keep the name. There are some more names: Safiyyah, Ayishah, Zainab, Ruqayyah, Maryam etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
